description: Automated compliance checklist and verification schema for Complete The Apsc Registration.

requirements.name: Proof of Identity
requirements.description: Government-issued photo identification (Aadhaar Card, Passport, Driver's License, Voter ID, or National ID Card).
requirements.validation_hints: Must be a valid, unexpired government-issued document displaying full legal name.

requirements.name: Proof of Current Address
requirements.description: Recent utility bill, bank account statement, rental agreement, or official residency proof.
requirements.validation_hints: Must match the applicant's current residential address and be recently dated if a recurring utility bill.

requirements.name: Proof of Date of Birth
requirements.description: Birth Certificate, Aadhaar Card, Matriculation Certificate, or Passport.
requirements.validation_hints: Date of birth must be consistent across all submitted documents without discrepancy.
